headline.zh: ChipMango 芯片设计云端协作

scenario.zh: 为智能门锁客户设计低功耗传感器芯片,在拉各斯和远程团队间协作验证
scenario.en: Design low-power sensor chip for smart lock client, verify across Lagos and remote teams

instruction.zh: 客户需要超低功耗传感器芯片,如何开始项目?
instruction.en: Client needs ultra-low-power sensor chip, how to start?

label.zh: 使用 Arm IP 模板

output.zh: 规格文档已加载 Cortex-M0+ 低功耗配置,团队可直接修改参数
output.en: Spec loaded with Cortex-M0+ low-power config, team can edit parameters

output.zh: 创建空白规格文档,需定义完整架构,设计周期较长
output.en: Blank spec created, full architecture needed, longer design cycle

instruction.zh: 拉各斯团队完成 RTL 设计,下一步如何验证?
instruction.en: Lagos team finished RTL design, how to verify next?

output.zh: 平台运行功耗和时序仿真,远程工程师并行审查波形数据
output.en: Platform runs power/timing simulation, remote engineers review waveforms in parallel

output.zh: 等待 FPGA 板到货,验证周期延长两周,但可测试实际场景
output.en: Wait for FPGA board delivery, adds two weeks but tests real scenarios

instruction.zh: 两个设计方案均通过测试,选择交付版本
instruction.en: Both designs passed tests, choose delivery version

output.zh: 功耗更低但唤醒时间120ms,适合电池供电应用
output.en: Lower power but 120ms wake, better for battery applications

output.zh: 唤醒时间80ms,响应更快,适合频繁交互的智能锁
output.en: 80ms wake, faster response, suits frequent-use smart locks

instruction.zh: 最终检查设计文档和测试报告
instruction.en: Final review of design docs and test reports

output.zh: 规格文档、RTL 代码和仿真报告已打包,客户可下载查看
output.en: Spec, RTL code and simulation reports packaged for client download

output.zh: 已邀请客户和拉各斯团队,准备在云端演示波形和功耗曲线
output.en: Client and Lagos team invited to demo waveforms and power curves online

takeaway.zh: 云端协作让分布式团队共享 IP 和工具,缩短芯片设计验证周期
takeaway.en: Cloud collaboration shares IP and tools across distributed teams, shortens chip design cycle

initial.zh: 传感器芯片:工作电压1.8V,待机电流<5µA,唤醒时间<100ms,支持I2C接口
initial.en: Sensor chip: 1.8V supply, standby <5µA, wake <100ms, I2C interface
